findings.title: Authorization check lets every non-admin export any organisation
findings.explanation: The `or` makes the check pass for any user whose role is not "admin", regardless of organisation. A regular user in org A can export org B's users.
findings.recommendation: Require both conditions: `return user.org_id == org.id and user.role == "admin"`, and add a test for the cross-org case.

findings.title: SQL injection through org_id
findings.explanation: org_id is interpolated into the SQL text; a value like `x' OR '1'='1` returns every user.
findings.recommendation: Use placeholders: conn.execute("... WHERE org_id = ? LIMIT ? OFFSET ?", (org_id, page_size, offset)).
